MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Dream With Me and Awakening feel like natural next choices because expressive classical crossover singing fits what I enjoyed in Stages and Under One Sky.",
    "Their relaxing accompaniment connects with my most recent interest in The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe while retaining the vocal emphasis I enjoy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums connect with earlier listening, but I want music for everyday relaxation now rather than a holiday mood.",
    "Contemporary vocal arrangements and Christian pop do not offer the gentle classical or theatrical sound I am seeking, even when they also emphasize singing.",
    "Something Beautiful gives me too little evidence of the sound I want; an appealing title alone is not enough for me to choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing preference for seasonal music on any visit.",
    "My enjoyment of expressive singers seems to have been stretched to include vocal music with quite different styles and accompaniment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest listening points toward a calm, relaxing sound, which matters more to me right now than the holiday connection in older choices.",
    "The combination of expressive voices and gentle orchestral or theatrical accompaniment matters more than simply having prominent vocals."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices partly recognize my taste for expressive singing but give too much weight to older holiday listening and too little to my current desire for relaxing classical crossover music."
}
